scope: Read-only MF-03B spool performance and machine-channel investigation; only temporary source copies, fixture data, probes and logs written
mainWorkingTree: Integration changes owned by root; no source changes made by this investigation
upstreamProbe: Exact Native.fs, OutputSpool.fs and fsproj from fixed Git objects copied to /tmp and single-module Fable-compiled. This is a direct source probe, not installed/public-package acceptance.

mainTail.actualImplementation: readLatestTail calls readChunks; NodeProcessHost.readFileAsyncChunks uses createReadStream with a 204800-byte highWaterMark. It scans the complete file asynchronously and keeps a small tail, not readFileSync of the complete file.
mainTail.callFrequency: Zero in-tree callers found across src, requirements and scripts; only .fs implementation and .fsi declaration. The benchmark invokes it directly. No current high-frequency production claim is justified.
mainTail.classification: P3 latent linear-read cost; no measured active production bottleneck

upstreamTail.actualImplementation: FileHandle.stat, start=size-min(size,limit), position-based FileHandle.read; only requested tail bytes are read.
upstreamTail.scope: Measured on stable completed fixture files. Concurrent external truncation/growth semantics and host live-spool ownership are not proved.

machineChannels.actualImplementation: Combined arrival chunks are put in one file at min(estimated output,204800). Git estimates 65536 bytes. requireText correctly refuses this mixed spool; the real adapter deletes the spool then returns the typed Error.
machineChannels.confirmedConsequence: Native git diff --no-index returns complete 164109-byte stdout, empty stderr and legitimate diff exit 1. Actual compiled OrchestratorGit.createRunner rejects the result on Node22 and Bun solely because it spooled. Small git --version controls pass.
machineChannels.priority: P2 existing availability boundary; preserve the safety refusal. It is not a reason to reinterpret mixed bytes as stdout.
machineChannels.upstreamDoesNotFixIt: Fixed upstream spool File result is also a raw merged stream with no channel metadata. Two different stdout/stderr assignments produce byte-identical files and result metadata, so a reader cannot recover both channels.

benchmark.method: One warmup then three measured reads per size/reader; 4096-byte tail. Main stream bytesRead and upstream FileHandle positioned reads are observed directly; returned hashes match. Main artifact SHA stayed unchanged within the run.
benchmark.bytesActuallyRead: Main reads the complete 1/16/64 MiB each time; upstream reads exactly 4096 bytes at file size minus 4096. Both return 4094 bytes after valid UTF8 alignment.
benchmark.limits: This host and warm local page cache only. RSS is sampled in a shared benchmark process and must not be used as a fresh-process memory comparison or a leak proof.

actualGitNode.meaning: True failed usability assertion after small-command positive control and exact raw native/spool byte comparison

actualGitBun.meaning: Same true failed usability assertion on Bun 1.3.14

upstreamChannelLossNode.meaning: Green probe confirms information loss, not correct dual-channel machine consumption

narrowRecommendation.firstPackage: Receive pure spool and replace only already single-channel capture storage: JsCallLoop owns distinct StdoutCapture/StderrCapture; JsSearch also creates separate stdout/stderr collectors. Keep one independent spool instance per existing channel owner. Do not merge these owners when crossing to File.
preserve: ProcessResult public end/stop/fault protocol and strict requireText refusal of mixed spools
Actual ReadOutput authority before file consumption
Complete machine output for parsing: never use readTail to parse Git stdout, rg JSON or NUL path lists
JsSearch existing 1 MiB capture failure bound and structured Host result budget
Current EOF, cancellation/deadline, Unknown and custodian cleanup semantics
narrowRecommendation.tail: Do not alter shared readChunks to seek, because its live callers need complete bytes. An isolated readLatestTail-to-positioned-reader replacement is possible but unused; do not prioritize or claim a hot-path improvement without a real caller.
narrowRecommendation.gitAvailabilityFollowup: Treat larger machine text as its own bounded output policy. Within the existing process owner, keep separate stdout/stderr spools and materialize complete channel text at the machine boundary only after confirmed closure; return existing InMemory text only when the complete conversion succeeds. Keep cancellation, deadline, fault and Unknown checks. A real caller-specific maximum text budget must be explicit; no silent limit, tail parsing, stdout guess, or new public process lifecycle protocol is needed.
narrowRecommendation.whyNotDoMoreNow: Current mixed result has already lost channel facts. A change only to requireText/GitAdapter cannot reconstruct them. Merely increasing EstimatedOutput also fails above the independent 204800 memory ceiling. A bounded machine materialization policy needs an explicit contract and focused work package, not a hidden change during pure spool reception.
likelyWriteSet: Independent library src/spool/** plus public package metadata
Main Spool.fs/.fsi and minimal NodeProcessHost fs I/O helpers only where redundant implementation can actually exit
JsCallLoop.fs and JsSearch.fs only if existing collector accessor adaptation is required
Numbered process-execution tests for per-channel overflow, raw bytes/BOM/CRLF, invalid UTF8 refusal where already required, file failures, authority and physical cleanup
narrowRecommendation.doNotIncludeWithoutSeparateApproval: Changing CapturedOutput/ProcessResult public union or making GitAdapter treat a merged File result as stdout

soak: The separate four-hour 3db7 package experiment remains running. Benchmark files/logs do not count as soak output or passing soak phases.
